description: This file defines the class 'actionCreateRecord' which extends 'actionBase' and contains methods to facilitate creating and managing records within the SuiteCRM environment. It includes functions for loading JavaScript, generating HTML forms, executing the creation action, setting records and relationships, and copying email addresses.

classes.name: actionCreateRecord
classes.description: A class responsible for creating new records in SuiteCRM, including rendering related JavaScript and HTML, setting field values, establishing relationships, and copying email addresses.

methods.name: loadJS
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript file(s) associated with this action.

methods.name: edit_display
methods.description: Generates and returns HTML form content for creating or editing a record, customized based on parameters.

methods.name: run_action
methods.description: Executes the create record action, including instantiating the target record, setting fields and relationships, copying emails, and saving the record.

methods.name: set_record
methods.description: Populates the fields of the given record based on parameters and the source bean.

methods.name: set_relationships
methods.description: Establishes relationships between the new record and existing entities based on provided parameters.

methods.name: copyEmailAddresses
methods.description: Copies email addresses from one bean to another, validating and returning the count of valid addresses.

methods.name: validateCurrentEmailAddress
methods.description: Validates that an email address structure contains all necessary fields.
